name_reason: Matches the fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and the uniform naming of every sibling in chevt1.c. The '_16' suffix is the dispatch-table slot index (idx 0x16 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91, confirmed: table base 0x51B91 + 0x16*4 = 0x51BE9 holds 0x00034819), a meaningful domain ID, NOT a Ghidra address residue (0x16 != self address 0x34819). '__ch6_char_cond' accurately reflects the body: chapter 6 turn-event, char-conditional (gated on char_id 8 alive). No rename needed.
purpose: Chapter 6 turn-15 char-conditional turn-event handler: if NPC 索倫 (char_id 8) is still alive, reload portrait set 1 and show chapter intro dialog page 3 (the elite-warrior-alive / reinforcement-warning beat); otherwise do nothing.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue (compiler-injected). Calls fd2_check_char_is_dead(8); if it returns non-zero (索倫 dead) returns immediately. If 索倫 alive (return 0) it calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1) then tail-JMPs (0x3483F -> 0x34906) to the named helper fd2_show_chapter_intro_text_dialog_mode_3, which displays chapter-text dialog page 3 with the fixed dialog geometry via fd2_display_dialog_scene. Single branch (the alive gate); no RNG, no numeric computation; the check return is used only as a zero test. Confirmed by disasm: PUSH 0x28/CALL __CHK; PUSH 0x8/CALL fd2_check_char_is_dead; TEST EAX,EAX; JNZ 0x34C1D (bare RET); PUSH 0x1/CALL fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp; JMP 0x34906.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatch arg from the uniform 1-arg cdecl per-event handler table at 0x51B91. The body never reads it (cast to void). Name matches every sibling handler in chevt1.c.
params.reason: Generic but correct and consistent: this is the uniform turn-event dispatch arg that this handler intentionally ignores; renaming would diverge from the rest of the dispatch-table family. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the conditional portrait reload + dialog display (or no-op when 索倫 is dead).

notes: Cross-checks: (1) dispatch table at 0x51B91 idx 0x16 -> 0x51BE9 = bytes 19 48 03 00 = 0x00034819, confirming the slot index in the name. (2) fd2-knowledge chapter 6 events: '第十五回合開始時，若精英戰士未死，則敵方萊汀率領十二名騎兵出現在下方' confirms turn-15 + elite-warrior(=索倫,char 8)-alive conditional. (3) Helper fd2_show_chapter_intro_text_dialog_mode_3 @ 0x34906 is a pure 9-PUSH+JMP thunk borrowing fd2_show_chapter_dialog_with_portrait_set_1's tail at 0x34C0F; its sole caller is this handler -> page-3 dialog. 索倫 is a chapter-6 NPC not in the strategy-guide's 32-char permanent roster; the name is an established in-project convention shared with sibling handler_15 @ 0x347D9 (same char_id 8 gate), so kept for consistency. src comment block (lines 891-918) is already accurate, ASCII, and precise (matches disasm incl. JNZ 0x34C1D bare-RET dead branch and the tail-JMP to the helper); Ghidra plate is consistent with src -> left untouched.
